name: Sahrawi Mint Tea
description: Sahrawi tea, sweetened green tea poured with ceremony across three rounds, is central to Sahrawi hospitality and nomadic desert culture, shared with the wider Maghreb tradition.
steps_detailed: Warm the tea with the mint 5 minutes.
Stir in the sugar until dissolved.
Pour from a height to build a light foam, traditionally poured across three distinct rounds.

name: Sahrawi Couscous
description: Couscous, tiny steamed semolina granules, is a genuine Sahrawi staple, reflecting real Berber and wider Maghrebi culinary roots.
steps_detailed: Simmer the chicken, carrot, and cumin in 1.5 cups water 25-28 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Pour the boiling broth over the dry couscous, cover, and let steam 5 minutes, then fluff.
Serve the stew and broth over the couscous.
